name: Bags
author: brodgar
description: Example addon (Phase 3c): hafen.ui.replace — replace the native inventory with a custom read-only view that draws the REAL items at their real grid positions ('wrap, don't reimplement', D-009). DORMANT until you press the 'toggle' hotkey (unbound until you assign it under Options > Keybindings > Bags; suggested Ctrl+Shift+I): that hands hafen.ui.replace the live inventory's Widget object, hides the native window and shows the custom Bags window in its place; press again — or disable/reload the addon — to restore the stock inventory. Registering replace also re-finds an ALREADY-OPEN inventory (the :reload case). Item moving (take/transfer/drop) is the gated Phase-4 actions tier, so the view is read-only (a click logs the item). 031: THE CLIENT'S OWN TOGGLE COMES WITH THE WINDOW — hiding a native window makes it yours, toggle included, and replace binds the view YOUR builder returns to it, so once replaced TAB and the inventory menu button open and close the custom 'Bags' window and the menu tick reads that window's own visibility (before this, Tab flipped `visible` back on the very window bags had hidden and the stock inventory came back ON TOP of the custom one). The hotkey is therefore an ARM/DISARM switch, not a show/hide key — that is Tab's job now — and disarming (or the view's X, or disable/:reload) gives the window and its key back under ONE rule: the stock inventory ends up AS THE USER WAS SEEING IT, open if the custom view was on screen and closed if it was not.
